name: uncommon-sales-skills
description: Ten sales-play skills that run enterprise deals the way top reps sell: in the buyer's own language, sourced from your live deal data, ending in a forwardable asset. Built on the Selling With and Brief & Brilliant frameworks.

interface.shortDescription: Run enterprise sales plays in the buyer's own language
interface.longDescription: A full toolbox of enterprise sales plays: multithreading, account planning, call prep and follow-up, champion enablement, competitive displacement, deal advancement, QBR prep, managing up, and the one-page business case. Each pulls your live deal context (Fluint first, with CRM, call, and email fallback), writes in the buyer's own language, applies a named framework, and ends in a forwardable deliverable. Start with the router if you are not sure which play you need.
